:::{#exm-pmf-density-counting}
#### The number of heads, integrated against counting measure

<!-- no-figure: a short sum of a few equal or tabulated probabilities; there is no data, curve or model to plot -->

For the number of heads $X$ in two fair coin flips,
with the [PMF](#def-pmf) $f_X$ of @exm-pmf,
let $\measure$ be the [counting measure](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures.html#def-counting-measure) on $\rangef{X} = \set{0, 1, 2}$.
For $A = \set{1, 2}$:

$$
\ba
\Pr(X \in \set{1, 2})
&= \int_{\set{1, 2}} f_X(x)\,d\measure(x)
&& \text{(a PMF is a density with respect to counting measure)} \\
&= f_X(1) + f_X(2)
&& \text{(an integral with respect to counting measure is a sum)} \\
&= \tfrac{1}{2} + \tfrac{1}{4}
&& \text{(the PMF of the number of heads)} \\
&= \tfrac{3}{4}
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

The first step is @prp-pmf-density-counting,
and the third uses the PMF values in @exm-pmf.

:::
